name: hyperion
description: A model-agnostic intelligence layer for software engineering.

enumDescriptions: Use an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint.
Use Anthropic's native Claude Messages API.
Send the model decider's selected model to GMI Cloud.
hyperion.provider.description: Provider used for chat execution. GMI Cloud accepts a model selected by an injected model decider and otherwise uses the fallback model.

hyperion.showStatusBar.description: Show the Hyperion status bar entry.

hyperion.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible provider. Hyperion appends /chat/completions unless it is already present.

hyperion.model.description: Model identifier sent to the OpenAI-compatible provider.

hyperion.anthropicApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the Anthropic Messages API. Hyperion appends /messages unless it is already present.

hyperion.anthropicModel.description: Claude model identifier sent to Anthropic.

hyperion.anthropicMaxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from the Anthropic Messages API.

hyperion.gmiApiBaseUrl.description: GMI Cloud inference base URL. Hyperion appends /chat/completions unless it is already present.

hyperion.gmiFallbackModel.description: GMI Cloud model used for direct chat until a model decider is injected. A decider result overrides this value per prompt.

hyperion.gmiMaxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from GMI Cloud.

hyperion.gmiOrganizationId.description: Optional GMI Cloud organization ID, sent as X-Organization-ID for multi-organization access.

hyperion.systemPrompt.default: You are a helpful software engineering assistant.
hyperion.systemPrompt.description: System prompt included at the beginning of each chat request.

hyperion.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds for a chat request.
